carpet.rule.commandFly.name: Enable fly command
carpet.rule.commandFly.desc: Allows players to use the /fly command to fly.
carpet.rule.commandScale.name: Enable scale command
carpet.rule.commandScale.desc: Allows players to use the /scale command to scale their own size.
carpet.rule.commandScaleMin.name: Minimum player scale
carpet.rule.commandScaleMin.desc: Sets the minimum value for player scaling.
carpet.rule.commandScaleMax.name: Maximum player scale
carpet.rule.commandScaleMax.desc: Sets the maximum value for player scaling.
carpet.rule.commandHome.name: Enable home command
carpet.rule.commandHome.desc: Allows players to use the /home command to teleport to their spawn point.
carpet.rule.commandHomeWorld.name: Enable home command world option
carpet.rule.commandHomeWorld.desc: Allows players to use the /home world command to teleport to the world spawn point.
carpet.rule.commandHomeCountdown.name: Home command teleport countdown
carpet.rule.commandHomeCountdown.desc: After executing the home command, teleportation occurs after the countdown finishes.
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.d: Allows players to use the /observerFreezeAreas command to freeze observers within the area.
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.e: [Note] The highlight sub-option is available when the client has the Feca mod installed.
carpet.rule.craftableReinforcedDeepSlate: Allows players to craft Reinforced Deepslate.
carpet.rule.craftableEndPortalFrame.name: Craftable End Portal Frame
carpet.rule.craftableEndPortalFrame.desc: Allows players to craft End Portal Frames.
carpet.rule.boneMealCopySapling.name: Bone Meal Copies Sapling
carpet.rule.boneMealCopySapling.desc: When a block directly above a sapling is Obsidian, using Bone Meal on it has a chance to drop a copy of that sapling. The chance equals the sapling's growth success rate.
carpet.rule.boneMealCopySmallFlowers.des: Allows using Bone Meal to duplicate small flowers.
carpet.rule.boneMealCopySmallFlowers.ext: This feature may be overridden by carpet-AMS's fertilizableSmallFlower. If it doesn't work, please enable both options.
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenSugarCane.name: Bone Meal Ripens Sugar Cane
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenSugarCane.desc: Allows Bone Meal to ripen Sugar Cane.
carpet.rule.boneMealRipenChorusFlower.de: Allows using Bone Meal to ripen Chorus Flowers.
carpet.rule.chorusFruitAsSeed.name: Chorus Fruit as Seed
carpet.rule.chorusFruitAsSeed.desc: Allows Chorus Fruit to be used as a seed. Right-click on the top face of End Stone to plant it.
carpet.rule.mineableBuddingAmethyst.name: Mineable Budding Amethyst
carpet.rule.mineableBuddingAmethyst.desc: Allows players to mine Budding Amethyst.
Allows players to mine Reinforced Deepslate.
carpet.rule.activeMending.name: Active Mending
carpet.rule.activeMending.desc: Items with the Mending enchantment worn by the player (main hand/off hand/armor slots) will actively consume experience to repair themselves.
carpet.rule.betterGlowLichenCopy.name: Better Glow Lichen Duplication
carpet.rule.betterGlowLichenCopy.desc: When using Bone Meal on Glow Lichen, it will directly drop as an item.
carpet.rule.stackableTotemOfUndying.name: Stackable Totem of Undying
carpet.rule.stackableTotemOfUndying.desc: Changes the stack limit of Totem of Undying to 64.
carpet.rule.stackableWaterBucket.name: Stackable Water Bucket
carpet.rule.stackableWaterBucket.desc: Changes the stack limit of Water Buckets to 64.
carpet.rule.bucketStackingBoost.name: Empty Bucket Stacking Boost
carpet.rule.bucketStackingBoost.desc: Changes the stack limit of Buckets to 64.
carpet.rule.voidBucket.name: Void Bucket
carpet.rule.voidBucket.desc: A bucket with the Infinity enchantment can infinitely pick up fluids (but produces no output).
carpet.rule.infiniteWaterBucket.name: Infinite Water Bucket
carpet.rule.infiniteWaterBucket.desc: A water bucket with the Infinity enchantment can infinitely place water.
carpet.rule.goldenCarrotCompost.name: Golden Carrot Composting
carpet.rule.goldenCarrotCompost.desc: Allows using Golden Carrots in the Composter, with a 100% success rate.
carpet.rule.villagerDropSpawnEgg.name: Villager Drops Spawn Egg
carpet.rule.villagerDropSpawnEgg.desc: Adult villagers (non-Nitwit) that have never traded and are killed by a player drop their Spawn Egg.
carpet.rule.stopCreeperGriefing.name: Stop Creeper Griefing
carpet.rule.stopCreeperGriefing.desc: Prevents Creeper explosions from damaging terrain and harming villagers.
carpet.rule.playerCannotPushBoat.name: Prevent Players from Pushing Boats
carpet.rule.entityCannotPushBoat.name: Prevent Entities from Pushing Boats
carpet.rule.entityCannotPushBoat.desc: Prevents any entity from pushing boats.
carpet.rule.projectileCantBreakDecorated: Prevent Projectiles from Breaking Decorated Pots
Prevents projectiles from breaking Decorated Pots.
